identity.name: ARX X5
identity.physical_model: X5A with modified fingers and wrist cameras
identity.hardware_variant: Exact product variant is not established. Other X5 variants have different geometry and limits.

kinematics.frame_convention: Joint origins are parent-to-joint transforms: parent-frame translation, then fixed rotation, then joint motion about the local joint axis. Axis signs are not world directions.
kinematics.mount_warning: Configuration defaults are not current measured T_world_base. Environment and world frames can differ.

pose_interface.pose_units: position m; quaternion_xyzw; named angles_deg relative to the top-down reference, not world Euler angles
pose_interface.gripper_warning: Commands, measured joint displacements, and mesh surface gap are distinct. qcmd at g=0 is below the authored joint lower bound.
pose_interface.home_warning: Episode home is the saved initial measured state, not necessarily the all-zero spawn configuration.

distal_flat_pad_gap.q7_q8_units: m; actual physical joint positions, not normalized commands
distal_flat_pad_gap.warning: robot asset surface distance, not manufacturer hardware jaw-width rating; rigid geometry only, no contact deformation or solver tolerance. Normalized command mapping qcmd=-.01+.054*g extends below URDF/USD lower bound; do not treat qcmd as achieved q.
distal_flat_pad_gap.collision_scope: The same inward support planes bound the ideal convex hulls. Filling concavities may increase contact extent elsewhere. Actual cooked contact boundaries, contact/rest offsets and dynamic solver separation are unmeasured; this is not an exact contact-onset distance.

geometry.finger_shape: Modified jaws have sloped inner shanks and distal flat pads of length 0.015 m; clearance varies with insertion depth. Visual and collision finger meshes have the same rigid-link geometry.

planning_collision.sphere_frame: Each named link local frame; sphere center and radius in metres.

geometry.interpretation: Visual meshes, PhysX collision approximations, planner spheres and harness finger bounds serve different purposes. Sampled previews cannot establish continuous clearance or physical contact. The wrist cameras and other arm also occupy space.

native_model.coordinates: Use the assembly relative paths, visual origins/scales and joint transforms, plus GLB mesh-node transforms. Mesh coordinates are in metres; do not add an axis conversion.

dynamics.mass_interpretation: Model inertia inputs, not measured product weight or payload. Camera masses are unspecified.
dynamics.precedence: Configured actuator and articulation settings override authored settings where specified. Neither set certifies hardware ratings or current achieved motion. Robot gravity is disabled by configuration; objects may still have gravity.
dynamics.authored_drive_units: Revolute authored drive coordinates are degrees (stiffness and damping per degree); prismatic coordinates are metres. Configured arm drive gains use radians. Equivalent inertia values retain the joint quantity and must not be interpreted as a product payload rating.

gripper.native_bias_warning: Native internal bias is distinct from the harness pad_center contact offset of 0.1501 m; do not add both.
gripper.measured_position_warning: Commands, measured joint displacements, and mesh surface gap are distinct. qcmd at g=0 is below the authored joint lower bound.

default_harness.interpretation: Static configuration defaults. Current robot_capabilities, action_speed and measured q/qdot take precedence; effective runtime overrides are not established here.

default_spawn_joint_positions.warning: spawn/default pose only; Harness home_check captures episode initial measured link6 pose instead

control.planner_joint_space_units: By joint_names order: revolute positions in rad, finger positions in m; corresponding acceleration and jerk units per second squared and cubed. Planning bounds are not measured tracking rates.

preview_gripper_mapping.interpretation: Forecast finger clearance is approximate. Use measured finger joint positions for current geometric opening.

control.execution: Cartesian tools select joint trajectories and position drives track them. Tracking may lag or stall; speed presets adjust command timing and do not guarantee physical speed. Paused simulation advances through actions and supported robot_wait, not wall-clock reasoning.
control.motion_evidence: Requested targets, plans, commands, measured achieved poses, contact, retained grasp and release are distinct. A successful plan is not proof of execution or retention. Episode home is the initial measured state, not necessarily the default spawn pose.

limitations: Static robot knowledge, not live episode state or a manufacturer safety specification. Runtime robot_capabilities, measured proprioception and current tool contracts take precedence.

A fully constrained pose generally leaves no free elbow degree of freedom on a 6R arm. IK branches, joint limits and singularities affect feasibility. Local solver failure does not establish global unreachability.

A clear contact-point trajectory does not establish clearance of the full arm, wrist camera, other arm or held object. Wrist rotation requires flange translation to hold an offset contact point fixed.
Reliable payload, friction, force/torque curves, grip force, backlash, compliance, repeatability and validated stopping response are not established.
